info.title: shisho API
info.description: HTTP API, OpenAPI doc, and embedded SPA for shisho

get.summary:
Encryption status (admin only). Reports whether at-rest encryption is on, the
active KEK version, and when it was last rotated. Never returns key material.

post.summary:
Deactivate a user (admin only). An admin cannot deactivate themselves, which
would risk locking the instance out of its only admin.

get.summary: List the OAuth clients connected to the caller's account, one row per client.

delete.summary:
Revoke a connected client: delete every token it holds for this user. The
connector stops authenticating immediately.

get.summary: Liveness check. Pings the database and reports `ok`.
Instance name, version, and auth mode.
List API keys (metadata only, never key material).

post.summary: Create an API key. The response is the only time the plaintext is shown.

delete.summary: Revoke (hard-delete) an API key. It stops authenticating immediately.

get.summary: The caller's current taste profile plus any pending proposal.

put.summary: Directly edit the profile, applying a new version immediately.

post.summary: Approve a pending proposal, applying it as the current profile.
Reject a pending proposal; the current profile is unchanged.

get.summary: The caller's current profile as raw Markdown (for copy/download).
The caller's version history, newest first, each with its rendered diff.

404.description: Setup is closed or the token is wrong

post.summary:
Generate and reveal an admin key, then consume the setup token (single-user
mode only; multi-user identities come from configured providers).

404.description: Setup is closed or the token is wrong

post.summary:
Trigger a MangaBaka dump refresh in the background. Returns immediately; the
refresh (download + ingest) runs to completion asynchronously and the
provider serializes overlapping runs. Poll `GET /status` for `refreshRunning`
and the new dump age.

get.summary:
The caller's verdict log, filtered and grouped by session (most recent
session first). The whole log is small by construction, so filtering and
grouping happen in memory.

post.summary:
Record a reading outcome for the series a verdict points at. Appends a
feedback row (the log stays append-only) and closes any open reconciliation
question on the series.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the verdict whose series the outcome is for

get.summary: Return the authenticated caller's key id, user id, and granted scopes.

AdminUser.description: One user in the admin list.

deactivatedAt.description: NULL when active; the deactivation timestamp otherwise.

ApiKeyResponse.description: A stored key, sans any secret material.

required.description: Codex is the required tier; Tsundoku is an enhancement.

ConnectionResponse.description: A client holding a live grant on the current user's account.

clientName.description: Display name from dynamic registration, if the client provided one.

connectedAt.description: When this client was first authorized (ISO 8601, earliest live grant).

expiresAt.description: Latest access-token expiry across this client's live grants (ISO 8601).
ISO 8601 expiry; never expires when omitted.

scopes.description:
Granular `resource:action` scopes (e.g. `example:write`). The aliases
`read`/`write`/`admin` are also accepted and expanded. Defaults to
read-only (`example:read`).

CreatedKeyResponse.description: POST response: the only place the plaintext key ever appears.

key.description: The full API key. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

EditProfileRequest.description:
A direct edit: the full replacement content, optionally pinned to the version
it was drafted against (a stale base is rejected).

baseVersion.description: The version this edit was drafted against; a mismatch is a 409.

changeSummary.description: One-line summary of what changed; defaults to a generic web-edit note.

EncryptionStatus.description:
Read-only encryption status. Never includes key material: key management is
a deployment-layer concern (config + the `shisho encryption` CLI).

kekVersion.description: The active KEK version wrapping the data key, if a keyfile exists.

lastRotatedAt.description: When the data key was last (re)wrapped (first init or KEK rotation).

ErrorBody.description: Wire format of every error response.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (clients switch on this).

mangabaka.description: The MangaBaka metadata backbone (dump + API fallback).

InfoResponse.description:
Instance metadata. Field names are part of the public API contract
(`auth_mode` is snake_case by convention).

name.description: Configured display name of this instance.

MangabakaHealth.description:
Backbone state: the dump is the healthy mode; API-only (dump not loaded)
reports degraded so a first deploy knows to run the initial ingest.

MintedKeyStatus.description:
The caller's minted Codex key state. `present` says a key is stored; the UI
offers the OIDC re-auth "regenerate" flow when the user wants a fresh one (or
when it has been revoked and the per-user surfaces started failing).

codexUserSub.description: The resolved `codex_user_sub`, when a key is stored.

present.description: A Codex key is stored for this user.

PendingProposalDto.description: A stored pending proposal (a `consolidate` output awaiting review).

baseVersion.description: The version it was drafted against.

changeSummary.description: One-line summary of what changed and why.

diff.description: Unified diff from the current profile to the proposal.

version.description: The version this proposal will become if approved.

ProfileResponse.description: The current taste profile plus any pending proposal awaiting review.

content.description: The current profile content (Markdown). Empty for a version-0 profile.

oneOf.description: A consolidation proposal awaiting the user's approval, if one is pending.

updatedAt.description: When the current version was applied (ISO 8601), absent at version 0.

RecordOutcomeRequest.description: The reading outcome to record for a series.

SessionGroup.description: One recommendation session's rows, grouped together.

startedAt.description: The earliest row in the session (ISO 8601).

SetupKeyResponse.description: The revealed admin key. Returned exactly once.

key.description: Plaintext admin API key. Store it now; it is never shown again.

providersConfigured.description: Number of `[[auth.providers]]` already present in config.

health.description:
Backend reachability + cache freshness + backbone state (mirrors the MCP
`status` tool and the health probe).

oneOf.description:
The caller's library snapshot view, when a warm snapshot exists (built on
their last authenticated touch). Absent when none is cached — no Codex
call is made from this browser session.

mintedKey.description: The caller's minted Codex key state.

codexUrl.description:
Deep link to the series in Codex, where metadata matching is fixed
(PRD Principle 8: fix at the source, never patch mappings locally).

rawSources.description: The raw `source:externalId` strings that failed to map, verbatim.

VerdictDto.description: One verdict-log row, as the UI renders it.

outcome.description: The reading outcome recorded on this row (feedback rows carry it).

retractionReason.description:
`failedVerification` (stays excluded from pools) or `withdrawn` (returns
to candidacy), when retracted.

seriesId.description:
Canonical `provider:id` (or `mangabaka:<id>`) when the row carries a
series identity, else absent.

VersionDto.description: One entry in the version history, with its rendered diff.

diff.description: Unified diff from the base version's content to this version's.

WhoAmI.description:
The caller's verified identity. `keyId`/`userId` are null when the static
config key authenticated (it lives outside the database).

tags.name: shisho
tags.description: Core endpoints: health, instance info, and the authenticated-identity echo.

tags.name: keys
tags.description: API key management. Requires the keys:manage scope. Scopes are granular resource:action strings; the aliases read/write/admin are accepted on creation and expanded.

tags.name: connections
tags.description: Connected-application (OAuth grant) management. Lists the OAuth clients holding a live grant on the caller's account and revokes one. Requires the keys:manage scope, so a browser session qualifies but a connector's own token does not.

tags.name: profile
tags.description: Taste-profile management: read the current profile and version history, edit it directly, and approve or reject pending consolidation proposals. Reads require profile:read, writes profile:write.

tags.name: verdicts
tags.description: Verdict-log browsing and outcome recording. Lists the append-only recommendation log filtered and grouped by session, and records a reading outcome (appended as a feedback row, never an in-place edit). Reads require verdicts:read, the outcome append verdicts:write.

tags.name: status
tags.description: Operational status: backend reachability, cache freshness, MangaBaka dump age + refresh state, the caller's unresolvable-series list (with Codex deep links), and minted-key state. The dump-refresh action runs in the background. Reads require status:read, the refresh action status:write.

tags.name: admin
tags.description: Admin-only operations. In single-user mode the sole operator is the admin; in multi-user mode admin is the admin_emails/admin_groups allowlists, or the first provisioned user when both are empty.

tags.name: setup
tags.description: First-run setup wizard. Token-gated and available only on an unconfigured instance; every route 404s once a credential is configured.
